name: name
behavior: Unique extension name; duplicate or empty registration throws
reason: The signed plugin manifest identifier replaces the mutable JavaScript registration name.

name: commands
behavior: Register extension commands with source attribution
reason: Signed declarative command metadata maps to the canonical native command registry without executable script callbacks.

name: keybindings

name: menuCommands

name: loadedGraphNode

name: nodeCreated

name: beforeConfigureGraph
behavior: Mutate workflow JSON and append missing-node data before configure

name: afterConfigureGraph
behavior: Run after graph configure with missing-node data
reason: Arbitrary post-configuration callbacks are not executable in native GPUI.

name: onAuthUserResolved
behavior: Receive latest anonymized auth user and future changes
reason: Profile-scoped anonymized account events remain disabled until the native provider UI task exposes a typed event contract.

name: onAuthTokenRefreshed
behavior: Receive auth token refresh notification
reason: Raw authentication tokens are never exposed to plugins or UI contributions.

name: onAuthUserLogout
behavior: Receive logout notification
reason: Profile-scoped logout events remain disabled until the native provider UI task exposes a typed event contract.

name: onNodeOutputsUpdated
behavior: Receive node output map replacement
reason: Global output-map callbacks are not executable; invocation-scoped declarative UI state remains available through the WIT API.
